result:
Confirmed: all 12 failures are pre-existing on the unmodified baseline (unrelated environment/version issues), identical before and after my change. My change adds one new passing test (1330 vs 1329 passed) with zero new failures.

Summary of the fix:

**`src/attr/_make.py`** — `field_transformer(cls, attrs)` result is now wrapped in `list(...)`. Previously the result was assigned directly to `attrs`, but that value gets iterated multiple times afterward (mandatory-attribute-order check, alias resolution, `attr_names` list comprehension). If a user's `field_transformer` returned a generator instead of a list — which worked before #1401 introduced the extra iterations — only the first pass would see any items, silently dropping fields on subsequent passes.

**`tests/test_hooks.py`** — added `test_field_transformer_returns_generator`, a regression test using `field_transformer=lambda c, a: iter(a)` to ensure a generator-based transformer still produces correct fields.
